**Job Description:**

**Plant Director**

 

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As a **Plant Director**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Leading a team of employees dedicated to making what is indispensable to empower modern life, advance human progress, and deliver a brighter future through 3M Science.
* Overseeing plant environment, health, safety, regulatory and security practices that respect our environment, meet requirements established by regulatory bodies, protect our employees, and align with company expectations.
* Leading operational excellence through conscientious management and decisive actions in environment, health, safety, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, cost, and employee relations.
* Utilizing operational financial acumen to analyze and understand the financial implications of various choices and actions, making informed decisions based on financial data to maximize profits and minimize losses.
* Understanding and applying technology platform fundamentals and principles, thinking strategically, and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for business growth and operational efficiency.
* Accelerating value creation for our customers through responsive end-to-end supply chain performance and prompt resolution to customer inquiries.
* Developing strategic plans and budgets to drive continuous and sustainable improvements through the application of disruptive technology, lean six sigma methods, and effective employee engagement programs.
* Managing inventory, and influencing supplier performance.
* Championing inclusive programs that create a great place to work for all our employees and demonstrating behavior aligned with a work environment in which employees, consultants, and contract workers know that ethical and legal behavior is always expected of them.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution.
* Ten (10) years of experience in a manufacturing or production facility in private, public, government, or military environment.
* Five (5) years of experience in a plant leadership role.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Proven experience in plant leadership roles, demonstrating the ability to drive operational excellence and achieve results.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality control, and safety standards.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate future trends, effectively prepare for change, create and communicate change action plans, and implement sustainable change.
* Strategic mindset and the ability to develop and execute plans to meet operational goals.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in physical sciences, Operations Management, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
* Experience in proven continuous improvement process improvement methodologies.

**Work location:**

* **Onsite, Tonawanda, New York**

**Travel: May include up to 10%** **domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

records.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Company Description**

Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

 **Job Description**

The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.

Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**

In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:

Be Curious

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

 
**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

 
**Additional Information**

Benefits: 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

records.title: 7 Brew Director of Operations
records.description:
Description:

**Why 7 Brew? Because We Invest in YOU!**

At 7 Brew, it’s more than coffee—it’s about brewing smiles one cup at a time. We’re built on kindness, connection, and community, and every guest interaction is an opportunity to make someone’s day brighter.

Brewtopia, a passionate franchise group, is proud to bring the bold energy of 7 Brew to Southeast Michigan. With proven success in quick-service restaurants, we’re dedicated to operational excellence, people-first leadership, and a high-energy drive-thru experience that stands out.

We’re looking for a high-energy, people-first Director of Operations to lead our drive-thru coffee operations. This is a unique opportunity to shape the culture, systems, and guest experience from the ground up—and to grow with us as we expand.

**OUR VALUES**

* Strive for Excellence – We raise the bar every day.
* Elevate Others – We build people up.
* Results Driven – We focus on impact.
* Visionary – We dream big and lead with purpose.
* Exceed Expectations – We go beyond what’s expected.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Competitive Salary:** $125,000 base per year
* **Performance Bonus:** 15% target, tied to KPIs and company performance
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health insurance, 401K with competitive match, generous PTO
* **Car Allowance:** Up to $500 /month
* **Cellphone Stipend:** Up to $25 a pay
* **Growth & Learning:** Clear development plans and a culture of continuous improvement
* **More Than Coffee:** Infused energy drinks, Italian sodas, smoothies, teas, and more!

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The Director of Operations ensures consistency, quality, and efficiency across all locations—protecting the brand and growing guest loyalty. This role optimizes profitability, develops strong leaders, and executes strategic growth initiatives with relentless focus on the guest.

* **Operations & Guest Experience:** Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple drive-thru shops, ensuring speed of service, drink quality, food safety, cleanliness, and brand consistency.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, mentor, and develop Regional Leaders and General Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, recognition, and continuous growth.
* **Financial Management & Strategic Growth:** Own the P&L, manage labor and COGS, drive sales and flow-through, and collaborate with leadership to execute growth strategies and support new shop openings.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Drive Growth & Profitability:** Regularly review and adjust the budget and financial reports to ensure cost goals are met. Implement strategies to optimize labor, track performance against financial goals, and ensure key profit-driving actions are executed in a timely manner.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Conduct daily operational reviews to ensure adherence to brand standards. Regularly assess performance metrics, respond to customer feedback, and implement action plans to improve service quality.
* **Lead & Develop Teams:** Hold weekly one-on-one coaching sessions with Regional Managers, ensuring consistent training and development. Work with HR and other departments to fill staffing gaps quickly and develop training programs that align with business needs.
* **Foster Guest Satisfaction & Compliance:** Address and resolve guest concerns within 24 hours, ensuring that guest satisfaction is prioritized.
* **Collaborate & Align:** Actively participate in weekly leadership meetings, contribute to discussions, and align team goals with corporate objectives. Share progress updates and ensure all team members are informed and working toward shared priorities.
* **Culture Keeper:** Foster a recognition culture, coach privately and praise publicly, and promote healthy competition and collaboration across locations.

Requirements:

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Leadership & Team Management:** Proven ability to build, coach, and scale high-performing multi-unit teams
* **Financial Acumen:** Budgeting, P&L ownership, labor modeling, KPI-driven decisions
* **Operational Excellence:** Multi-unit drive-thru/QSR expertise with a bias for speed, quality, and safety
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Data-driven, resourceful, and decisive in a fast-paced environment
* **Communication:** Clear, candid communicator across shop, field, and corporate partners
* **Customer Focus:** Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences consistently
* **Strategic Planning & Execution:** Translate goals into disciplined, scalable routines
* **Compliance & Safety:** Knowledge of health, safety, and regulatory standards
* **Technology Proficiency:** POS/back-office, labor scheduling, spreadsheets/dashboards

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Multi-unit leadership in QSR/coffee/drive-thru; ideally **2+ years in a director-level role**
* Bachelor's in business management, Hospitality, or related field is a plus

**PHYSICAL AND TIME REQUIREMENTS**

* **General Mobility:** Sit, stand, bend, and move for extended periods during meetings, presentations, or line work
* **Manual Dexterity:** Proficiency in typing and using office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones
* **Visual and Auditory Acuity:** Ability to read printed and digital documents; clear hearing for communication
* **Lifting and Carrying:** Ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds
* **Travel:** Frequent travel to multiple locations (>75%)

**TIME REQUIREMENT**

* Availability to primarily work during areas of business growth, including nights and weekends.

**Ready to bring the brew and bring your best?**

Join the Brewtopia movement today! If you’re ready for an epic, energetic, and rewarding journey, we’d love to have you on the crew. But first – let’s get to know you better! Start your journey with us by completing a quick **5-7 minute Culture Index survey**. It's a key part of the process, and we promise – it’s quick, easy, and essential!

Survey Link: https://surveys.cultureindex.com/s/y8HlLcvMA4/93831

**Disclaimer**

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and expectations of the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, or requirements.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered fairly and without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status. Hiring decisions are made solely on job-related qualifications and business needs.

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
**At a Glance**

**Legrand** has an exciting opportunity for a **Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering** to join the **Electrical Infrastructure division.** This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.

This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.

**What Will You Do?**

**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

**Opportunity Portfolio and Investment Leadership**

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division’s technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quality at source, error-proofing, equipment reliability, operator safety, cybersecurity, and appropriate performance visibility.
* Establish preferred technology platforms, reusable equipment concepts, and qualified supplier and integrator networks where standardization creates value.

**Deployment and Sustainable Results**

* Lead the technical delivery of selected high-value, high-risk, or highly replicable manufacturing initiatives.
* Define when central AME involvement is required and when plant teams can execute within established standards.
* Establish clear ownership for technical development, plant readiness, commissioning, production ramp, and ongoing sustainment.
* Transfer solutions to plant ownership after safety, capability, reliability, training, documentation, maintenance, and performance requirements have been met.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to verify that operating and financial benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Capture lessons learned and creates replication methods for proven solutions.

**Organization and Capability Development**

* Build and develop a high-performance advanced manufacturing engineering team with the technical depth required to support the division’s strategy.
* Define which capabilities should be retained internally and which should be accessed through plants, internal partners, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, or system integrators.
* Establish expectations for supplier and integrator performance, documentation, intellectual property, lifecycle support, and reuse of developed solutions.
* Develop plant technical capability to minimize long-term dependence on central resources or external partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Experience:**

* At least 10 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing engineering, automation, process engineering, or industrialization, including five years leading technical teams or multisite programs.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, robotics, autonomation, controls, machine vision, advanced tooling, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience with equipment specifications, integrator management, design reviews, acceptance testing, commissioning, capability validation, and production handoff.
* Broad manufacturing-process knowledge and experience in both high-mix and higher-volume environments.
* Proven record of turning manufacturing technology investments into sustained operating and financial results.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of capital economics, lifecycle cost, capacity analysis, labor impact, and benefit realization.
* Ability to translate operating losses and business requirements into prioritized technical opportunities.
* Ability to determine when advanced technology is appropriate and when a simpler operational solution will create greater value.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into clear business decisions and influence across a matrixed organization.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Finance, Product Engineering, Quality, EHS, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Lean, and PMO teams.
* Strong supplier, equipment manufacturer, and system-integrator management capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with legitimate differences across products, processes, plants, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical professionals, develop organizational capability, and operate effectively across multiple businesses and manufacturing locations.

Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Its comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and datacenter markets makes it a benchmark for customers worldwide.

Bridging power from sources to pathways to touchpoints, Legrand’s Electrical Infrastructure division combines innovation and quality to provide leading solutions for an evolving energy landscape. Our expertly designed products enable customers to confidently address the complex needs and challenges of electrification, while enhancing everyday experiences like plugging in, switching on, and staying connected. Committed to best-in-class service at every stage, we act as a trusted partner for our customers to ensure each project’s success and their continued satisfaction. Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division includes the following brands and product lines: Girtz, Avtron, Power Bus Way, Cablofil, Connectrac, Wiremold and Pass & Seymour.

Legrand, North & Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company’s incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

records.title: Head of Construction Operations
records.description:
**About Charge Robotics**
-------------------------

Charge Robotics is a Series A startup building robots that build solar farms.

Demand for new solar projects is booming (one-fifth of all the solar that exists in the US was installed last year!), but today’s construction companies can’t keep up due to limited labor resources.

We thought this was insane, so we developed robots to directly address this bottleneck and speed up the world’s transition to renewables. We’ve shipped our first commercial system already, and are in the process of scaling up our operations to meet our massive demand.

Charge is a fast-moving company, which means constant opportunities for learning and growth. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company and our product, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. And you get to work with giant robots .

If you are excited to work on interesting technical & operational problems with direct climate impact, you’re going to fit right in at Charge Robotics.

Read more about Charge in recent press:

* YouTube - Introducing Sunrise, the assembly line for solar
* Fast Company - Solar Building Robots to Solve One of Climate's Biggest Problems
* MIT News - Making solar projects cheaper and faster with portable factories

We’re MIT-founded and backed by Silicon Valley’s top investors, including Founders Fund, Energy Impact Partners, Lux Capital, YC (S21), and more.

**About the role**
------------------

As Head of Construction Operations, you’ll own how Sunrise gets solar farms built in the field. You’ll run our deployments on utility-scale solar sites end to end, from site readiness and mobilization through daily production to demobilization, and build the team, playbooks and systems that take us from a handful of systems in the field to a fleet.

You’ll report directly to our CEO and work closely with our engineering, manufacturing and commercial teams. You’ll also be the main point of contact for our EPC customers’ field teams.

This is a rare chance to bring deep construction experience to a new way of building solar, and to define what a construction operation built around robots looks like.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

* **Run our field deployments.** Own every Charge project from site readiness and mobilization through production and demobilization, and deliver each one on schedule, on budget and to our quality and safety standards.
* **Scale from a few systems to a fleet.** Build the playbooks, staffing plans and field-to-HQ communication protocols that let us run multiple systems across multiple sites at once as our manufacturing ramps.
* **Build and lead the field organization.** Hire, train and lead site superintendents, operators, field engineers, technicians and local crews, and build a culture of ownership, safety, accountability and continuous improvement.
* **Own production performance and cost.** Track install rate, system uptime and cost per MW on every site, find what’s slowing us down, and drive the fixes in the field and back at HQ.
* **Be the voice of the field.** Turn what you learn on site into clear requirements, design feedback and acceptance standards for engineering and manufacturing, so every system arrives ready to build.
* **Lead customer relationships on site.** Serve as the primary point of contact for our customers’ field teams, give regular project updates, and resolve issues before they slow the job.
* **Shape what projects we take on.** Partner with our commercial team to assess site readiness, schedules and labor models for new projects, and bring operational input to pricing and contracts.
* **Own field safety and compliance.** Set and enforce our field safety program, and make sure every site meets OSHA, customer and environmental requirements.

**You bring**
-------------

* **10+ years in construction management, including 5+ in utility-scale solar.** You’ve led field operations on large solar projects, ideally tracker and module installation at an EPC or self-perform contractor.
* **A track record of running multiple sites at once.** You’ve managed several concurrent projects and owned their schedules, budgets and results.
* **Leadership in the field.** You’ve built and led field teams of superintendents, foremen and crews, developed leaders under you, and worked with both union and non-union labor.
* **A strong safety and quality record.** OSHA 30 or equivalent, and a history of safe, high-quality installation on large sites.
* **Command of the numbers.** You’re fluent in spreadsheets, cost tracking, and production reporting. You know how to measure the baseline of a metric so we can track its change over a set period of time.
* **A builder’s mindset.** You’re excited to run a construction operation built around new technology and can quickly turn lessons from the field into better processes for the company. Our HQ team that you'll work closely with is a ~30 person startup, which brings high growth and ownership but requires decisiveness, high operating speed, and comfort with ambiguity.
* **Industry presence.** Strong relationships across EPCs, developers and tracker OEMs, and comfort representing Charge at industry events.
* **Ability to travel 50–75% of the time.** Most travel for this role will be to active solar construction sites all over the US where we deploy Sunrise, with occasional trips to our HQ in San Leandro, CA.
* A degree in construction management, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience leading field work.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* **Tracker installation expertise,** especially on Nextpower (formerly Nextracker) systems.
* **Familiarity with Robotics.** Experience deploying automation, robotics or other first-of-a-kind equipment on construction sites.
* **Startup or scale-up experience.** You’ve built a field operation early on and know when to formalize a process and when to keep moving fast.
* **International projects.** Experience mobilizing equipment and crews for projects outside the US.
* **AI-positive mindset.** You've experimented with creating your own agents and workflows using AI tools/chatbots and are excited about how these could shape and improve the future of our work.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $220K - $260K

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Overview**
Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger
  
  
The Quality Director plays a pivotal role in leading and strengthening operational quality and quality compliance within a large-scale contract manufacturing facility. Responsible for both Product Quality and Quality Management System (QMS) compliance, this leader ensures quality operations within the manufacturing environment consistently meet customer, regulatory, and business expectations.
  
  
This individual combines strategic vision with hands-on operational quality leadership, ensuring Resonetics delivers world-class quality in a fast-paced, highly regulated medical device manufacturing environment. The role demands proven experience within manufacturing operations, deep expertise in ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820, mastery of advanced quality assurance techniques, and the ability to align and elevate quality performance across multiple value streams.

**Oklahoma City, OK**
**Extremely Competitive Pay**

**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product integrity, maintaining customer and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement throughout the company. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, and executive leadership, the Director of Quality will lead quality initiatives, develop high-performing teams, strengthen organizational processes, and promote a culture of accountability and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with proven leadership skills and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Implement and maintain the company quality system in coordination with the Management Representative.
* Report on the performance of the quality system for review and as a basis for improvement of the quality system.
* Have knowledge and understanding of the standards and customer requirements against which the quality system is developed, maintained, and implemented.
* Provide leadership to subordinates, establishing goals and development plans to meet the strategic direction of the organization.
* Determine and enforce -- through functional groups - quality requirements in accordance with real company needs, based on current regulations and state-of-the art product development.
* Develop audit plans, select, and evaluate auditors, document non-conformance(s) and report non-conformances to management.

records.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer

records.description:
**Description**
The
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
is responsible for leading LOPA’s overall quality strategy, overseeing the agency’s Quality Management System (QMS) and ensuring that all products, services, and internal processes meet or exceed internal and external customer expectations and regulatory standards. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, the position partners with operational leaders to translate requirements and quality findings into effective, measurable practices, fostering an agency-wide culture of integrity and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy & QMS Governance**

* Quality Management System. Own, maintain, and continuously improve the agency-wide QMS aligning objectives with organizational priorities and applicable standards.
* Program Implementation. Lead implementation and standardization of quality initiatives, establish milestones and accountabilities, monitor adoption, and assess ongoing effectiveness and sustainability.
* Policies. Oversee agency-wide development, implementation, including version control, approval workflows for all controlled documents. Support operational owners on content development and enforcement of policies and procedures.

**Regulatory Compliance & Audits**

* Compliance Oversight. Monitor compliance with applicable CMS requirements, OPTN policies and FDA regulations and other relevant industry standards and local and federal government regulations.
* Audit Readiness and Management. Oversee internal quality audits of donation and business processes to ensure regulatory and policy compliance, leveraging operational data to advise internal stakeholders on corrective actions; ensure ongoing monitoring of implemented changes to assess long-term effectiveness and sustainability. Serve as the primary liaison during external regulatory inspections and customer audits. Oversee agency’s response to any findings or observations from external audit.
* Quality records. Ensure quality records and compliance documentation are accurate, controlled, retrievable and inspection ready.

**Continuous Improvement & CAPA**

* Root-Cause Analysis. Oversees LOPA’s Occurrence Management Program to investigate instances of procedural non-conformance, resolve systemic issues, and prevent recurrence.
* Data and KPIs. Establish quality metrics, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and analyze statistical trends to identify efficiency gains within the QMS.
* Support Process Optimization. Partner with Operations leadership and the Performance Excellence team to embed quality and drive excellence in all process improvement initiatives.

**Leadership & Supplier Management**

* Team Development. Recruit, coach develop and evaluate a team of auditors and quality team members by setting priorities and performance expectations.
* Supplier Quality. Oversee vendor qualification, auditing, and performance monitoring to ensure specifications are met.
* Customer Relations. Collaborate directly with customers to resolve quality complaints, review technical specifications, and improve satisfaction.
* Escalation: Promptly communicates significant quality or regulatory concerns to CSO and recommend protective or corrective measures.

**Requirements**
**Degree.**
Bachelor’s degree in Quality Management, Life Sciences, Public Health, Business, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience.**
Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in quality management, assurance and/or control, regulatory compliance, auditing or related functions within a highly regulated environment, including at least two (2) years of supervisor, management or demonstrated functional leadership experience.
  
  
**Implementation Experience.**
Demonstrated experience implementing, managing or enhancing quality management systems, regulatory compliance programs, or organization quality initiatives required.
  
  
**Industry Background.**
Proven track record of applying knowledge of the principles of quality assurance/quality control. Experience within healthcare or donation and transplantation preferred.
  
  
**Skills & Certifications.**
Certified Quality Manager (ASQ CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Black Belt, or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) strongly preferred.
  
  
**Technical Expertise.**
Deep working knowledge of senior leadership of a Quality System. Experience applying CMS, OPTN, and FDA standards and regulations preferred.
  
  
**Leadership.**
Exceptional cross-functional communication, strong decision making and problem-solving capabilities; analytical thinker with keen ability to resolve conflict and influence executive stakeholders, adept at managing agency-wide change.

records.description:
**Summit Polymers is a leading, global supplier of automotive interior systems including consoles, door panels, and instrument panels. With over 50 years serving the industry, we deliver engineering and product excellence to our customers, on time, in budget, with the latest innovations.**
JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)
+ Assists in developing internal performance metrics that support successful customer scorecard results

* Interfaces with key customer personnel & engages customer quality events

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations
* Expertise in major automotive OEM quality systems; Ford Q1, GM BIQS, FCA, Nissan, VW, BMW, and Toyota
* Expert problem solving skills utilizing root cause based methods; Practical Problem Solving (PPS), 8D, and 5 why methodology
* Must be able to gather and analyze information easily and make appropriate decisions.
* Outstanding leadership, team building, coaching and decision making abilities
* Highly energetic, confident, and assertive with the ability to lead and motivate others
* Must have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* A minimum score of 50 on the Wonderlic Select Assessment (Traditional score of 28 on the cognitive portion).

**Travel Requirements**
This position typically does require approximately 18 weeks per year of travel to Summit Polymers Manufacturing Sites.
  
  
**DISCLAIMER**
The information contained in this job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Agreement to complete all post-hire required training.

Idea Nuova is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Production to lead and optimize domestic and international production operations across our growing portfolio of home textiles, home décor, and consumer products. This role oversees the full production lifecycle — from purchase order placement through manufacturing, delivery, and payment coordination — ensuring operational efficiency, cost control, and on-time execution. **Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee domestic and international production operations across multiple product categories and manufacturing partners

* Monitor production schedules, order status, and potential risks to ensure on-time delivery to major retail customers
* Partner with Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, Logistics, and Finance to align production with business priorities
* Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and overseas factories and suppliers

* Leverage ERP systems, Excel, and emerging technologies to improve planning, tracking, and decision-making

* Lead, mentor, and develop a production team of approximately 5–10 employees
* Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability
* Coach team members to strengthen problem-solving, vendor management, and operational execution
* Foster cross-functional collaboration and a proactive, solutions-oriented culture
* Represent the production department in leadership discussions and serve as a strategic partner to senior management

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in production, manufacturing, supply chain, or operations, including leadership responsibilities
* Proven experience managing domestic and international production operations
* Bilingual English and Chinese preferred
* Experience overseeing high-volume, high-SKU product portfolios
* Strong background in overseas factory management, vendor negotiations, production scheduling, and purchase order execution
* Experience leading and developing teams of 5–10 employees
* Demonstrated success implementing process improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP, production tracking, or supply chain management systems
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

* Establishes scalable systems and processes to support continued business growth
* Proactively identifies and resolves operational risks before they impact customers

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package

* Exposure to global manufacturing operations and major retail customers
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial work environment

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on Idea Nuova's global production organization. You'll work closely with senior leadership, oversee a diverse manufacturing network, and drive operational improvements across domestic and international production. The role offers the opportunity to modernize production processes, introduce automation, develop future leaders, and help scale a growing business serving some of the nation's largest retailers.

**Company Description**
The Father’s Table is a privately owned national dessert manufacturer based in sunny Sanford, Florida, known for its innovation and extensive product lines. The company serves multiple channels, including national retail accounts, food service, wholesale clubs, convenience stores, and school lunch programs, reaching far beyond local bakeries. Its offerings range from grab-and-go convenience items to decadent, restaurant-quality desserts such as creamy cheesecakes and home-style cake rolls. A unique production process and strong company values have helped The Father’s Table become the #1 branded cheesecake in the retail in-store bakery segment. Applicants can learn more about the company by visiting www.thefatherstable.com.

**Director of Manufacturing**

Department: Operations Reports To: President ,Direct Reports: Plant Managers, Senior Manager of Cheesecake Production, Position Summary: The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and operational leadership across two manufacturing facilities overseeing approximately 1,000 employees. This role serves as the primary architect of operational excellence moving the organization toward more data-driven decisions. The Director standardizes processes, drives toward modern manufacturing systems (KPIs, OEE, ERP), ensures food safety, and champions the successful implementation and optimization of our core cheesecake production lines.

---

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. Change Management & Professionalization**

· Standardize Operations: Develop, implement, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) across both plants to ensure consistency in quality, safety, and efficiency.

· Cultivate Leadership: Mentor, coach, and upskill plant managers and front-line supervisors, shifting the culture from firefighting to proactive, structured problem-solving.

· Data-Driven Culture: Introduce and track rigorous key performance indicators (KPIs) and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) metrics to guide daily, weekly, and monthly business reviews.

**2. Core Product Implementation & Optimization (Cheesecake Operations)**

· Product Optimization: Partner with the Senior Production Manager to evaluate all new cheesecake formulas, sizes, and configurations introduced into production.

· Constraint Assessment: Review new product introductions to assess potential issues or constraints affecting quality performance, labor efficiency, run rates, and operating costs.

· Executional Direction: Provide hands-on, "feet-on-the-floor" leadership to the operations team during major line optimizations, ERP system changes, and plant renovations.

**3. Food Safety, Quality & Compliance**

· Regulatory & Legality: Ensure both facilities strictly adhere to FDA, USDA, OSHA, and local regulations, taking ultimate responsibility for the safety and legality of all food products.

· Audit Readiness: Maintain "always audit-ready" standards for SQF, BRC, or other GFSI-benchmarked certifications and retail customer audits.

· Safety Culture: Champion a zero-injury safety culture through robust Hazard Identification, training, and behavioral safety programs.

4. Financial & Strategic Management

· P&L Responsibility: Manage the manufacturing budget, labor costs, variances, and operational expenses across both plants.

· CAPEX Planning: Identify, justify, and execute capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects aimed at automation, capacity expansion, and facility modernization.

---

**Required Qualifications**

· Experience: 10+ years of progressive food production operations management experience, with at least 5+ years in a multi-plant or regional leadership role.

· Scale & Product Expertise: Proven track record of managing a large workforce (500–1,000+ employees) in high-volume environments, with deep knowledge of automated bakery or cheesecake production processes.

· Transformation Experience: Demonstrated success leading an organization through a professionalization journey or significant operational scaling.

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

· Certifications: Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt highly desirable. Full understanding of SQF/BRC and HACCP systems.

---

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

· Mobility: Must be able to travel between both manufacturing facilities on a daily/regular basis and spend significant time on the shop floor.

· Environment: Willingness to work in production environments with moderate-to-high noise levels (requiring hearing protection) and varying temperatures ranging from 45°F to 95°F.

* · Physical Capability: Ability to stand and walk for extended periods (up to 8–12 hours) during plant walkthroughs and occasionally lift or handle up to 35–50 lbs when assisting on the line

records.description:
**Company Background and Summary**

Votaw Precision Technologies is a trusted leader in the manufacturing of complex precision components, assemblies, and systems for the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors. With a strong reputation for technical excellence, quality craftsmanship, and on-time delivery, Votaw supports some of the world’s most demanding programs through its advanced manufacturing capabilities. The company specializes in precision machining, fabrication, welding, and complex assembly operations for mission-critical applications. Votaw Precision Technologies has long been a trusted partner in building mission-critical hardware for some of the most advanced aerospace and defense programs in the world. Our precision components support the International Space Station, nearly every major launch vehicle in operation, high-performance spacecraft (including classified missions), as well as next-generation fighter aircraft, bombers, submarines, radar systems, and ground vehicles.

We are seeking an experienced and highly knowledgeable Operations Director to lead the overall operations of a high-performance CNC machine shop. This individual will have full responsibility for the day-to-day management, technical excellence, production performance, staffing, scheduling, efficiency, and continuous improvement of the facility.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned machining professional with approximately 20 years of industry experience who understands metal cutting and CNC machining at a deep technical level and has progressed into a strong operational leadership role.

The Operations Director must be able to walk onto the shop floor, understand the machining challenges, evaluate processes, communicate effectively with machinists and programmers, identify inefficiencies, and make sound technical and operational decisions. The company utilizes a variety of CNC machining technologies, including 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis machining, as well as vertical milling, welding and large-scale assembly tooling.

**Essential Functions**

* Responsible for ensuring that the entire organization operates safely, efficiently, profitably, and to the highest standards of quality and technical excellence.
* Have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the CNC machine shop.
* Establish and maintain a culture of technical excellence, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Provide leadership and direction to machining, programming, production, quality, maintenance, and other shop personnel.
* Ensure the shop has the appropriate personnel, equipment, tooling, processes, and resources to meet customer requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for supervisors, leads, machinists, programmers, and support personnel.
* Serve as the primary operational leader and decision maker for the manufacturing facility.
* Work closely with programmers, machinists, and engineers to resolve technical machining issues.
* Evaluate machining processes and identify opportunities to improve cycle time, tool life, throughput, and quality.
* Ensure manufacturing processes are technically sound, repeatable, and scalable.
* Provide technical guidance when difficult or complex machining problems arise.
* Maintain an environment where machinists, engineers, programmers continuously improve their technical capabilities.
* Responsible for weld shop, tooling assembly, and manufacturing readiness team.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Approximately 20 years of experience in the CNC machining/manufacturing industry.
* Previous experience as a Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Operations Manager, Plant Manager, Production Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Experience managing multiple shifts and 24/7 operations
* Knowledge of complex, tight-tolerance, or high-value machined components.
* Experience with 5-axis machining and advanced CNC manufacturing.
* Implementing Lean Manufacturing or continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of ERP/MRP and production scheduling systems.
* Managing capital equipment purchases and machine capacity planning.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, or other high-precision manufacturing environments is a plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly self-motivated and directed.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

**Work Conditions**

* Ability to work onsite, including hours outside of a normal working day, to meet critical deadlines.
* This position operates within a precision manufacturing environment supporting the production of mission-critical aerospace and defense components. Success requires a high sense of urgency, attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple departments to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations and customer delivery commitments.
* Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment, including walking the production floor, climbing stairs or ladders, occasionally lifting up to 25 pounds, and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

**Additional Requirements**

* This position requires the use of information or access to hardware subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons as defined by ITAR.

***Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.***

***Votaw Precision Technologies, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Disability/Vets.***

* Direct Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning functions, ensuring effective coordination, accountability, and alignment with site and corporate objectives.

* Ensure manufacturing processes, product traceability, configuration and change control, and supporting documentation comply with applicable customer, industry, regulatory, and company requirements.

* Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with production disruptions, supplier constraints, quality concerns, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Represent site operations in corporate leadership discussions, customer interactions, audits, and strategic planning activities, communicating performance, priorities, and resource requirements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity overseeing multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations with accountability for production, engineering, quality, supply chain, and cross-functional business objectives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, materials management, and operational performance improvement.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing engineering principles, process controls, technical problem resolution, and new product introduction activities.
* Working knowledge of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, corrective action processes, and applicable manufacturing standards.
* Proven ability to develop and execute operational strategies, establish performance objectives, and achieve measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
